title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-07-21
content:
Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-07-21
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Diego Martinez, Evelyn Cho, Liam O'Connor, Samir Rao (sales), Karen Wu (SRE, partial)
Missing: Priya Nair (customer success)

Agenda:
- Quick round updates (2m each)
- Customer integration status deep-dive (priority customers)
- Blockers & escalation needs
- Action items & owners
- Next meeting cadence confirmation

Notes / Updates by customer:
1) Atlas Health (pilot, Dedicated)
- Current phase: Validation + end-to-end smoke tests in staging (config pinned to v1.3.0, 8xA100 dedicated pool)
- Progress this week: Completed prefix/KV cache validation for patient note workflows; SLA smoke test passed 95/100 queries under 120ms median
- Open issues: Intermittent model fallback observed when autoscale triggers (fallback to quantized variant shows 3% token-level hallucination increase)
- Blocker: Product routing policy not fully propagated to private control plane (causes fallback behavior)
- Escalation: Need infra SRE to validate routing table propagation (Karen assigned)
- Next steps: Diego to run focused load test across 3 shards Wednesday 7/22; Evelyn to run hallucination regression check with 50 curated prompts by 7/23

2) Frontline CRM (hosted-api -> Dedicated trial)
- Current phase: Onboarding + data-posting connectors
- Progress: Ingest pipeline for embeddings completed; initial similarity search QA passed internal thresholds
- Open issues: Rate-limit spikes during bulk import (customer uses 4 parallel workers) causing 429s and backoff loops in their ETL
- Workaround: Temporarily increase per-customer burst quota and implement client-side jitter
- Action: Aisha to approve temporary quota bump through Console by EOD 7/21; Samir to communicate to customer

3) Equinox Financial (Private deployment in VPC)
- Current phase: Network & KMS integration
- Progress: HSM integration validated offline; VPC peering scheduled 7/24 with their infra team
- Blocker: VPN MTU mismatch leading to occasional dropped connections on large model downloads (~2% failure rate)
- Owner: Liam to coordinate with infra and their network team; target fix 7/25
- Notes: Compliance checklist items 3.1 and 3.2 signed off

4) ArkCommerce (optimize + serving runtime tuning)
- Current phase: Cost/perf optimization pilot (Reduce token cost by batching + int8 quantization)
- Progress: Prototype quantized model reduced per-token GPU time by ~28% in synthetic bench; end-to-end app-level latency regressed by ~10ms in tail
- Open issues: Some structured output formatting changed for product title extraction when running int8 variant
- Action: Solutions to prepare a prompt-engineering mitigation (post-processing mapping) and re-run evals by 7/28

Cross-customer themes / platform items:
- Autoscaling & fallback behavior: Multiple customers hit fallback variants when autoscale policies change. Root cause suspected: race condition in routing policy propagation during pool scaling events.
  - Short term: Increase logging around routing updates; introduce a 2s grace window before allowing fallback when scale event is detected.
  - Owner: Karen (SRE) + Diego (serving runtime) to propose a mitigation by 7/26.

- Observability gaps: Token-level cost attribution for private deployments is inconsistent in Console for some customers (seen in Atlas and Equinox).
  - Action: Engineering to add missing telemetry tags for private control plane by 7/29. Owner: Evelyn.

- Documentation / onboarding: New clients on Dedicated report confusion around model pinning semantics during rollouts.
  - Proposal: Draft a short how-to (1-pager) and add example config snippets to Console docs. Owner: Aisha. Draft due 7/27.

Blockers summary (high priority):
- Routing propagation race during autoscale (affects Atlas, Frontline) — Owner: Karen + Diego — target 7/26
- VPN MTU / large model download failures for Equinox — Owner: Liam — target 7/25
- Token-level telemetry missing for private control plane — Owner: Evelyn — target 7/29

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Diego: Focused load test across 3 shards for Atlas, report results (7/22) [IN PROGRESS]
- Evelyn: Hallucination regression test for Atlas; add telemetry tags for private control plane (7/23 & 7/29) [IN PROGRESS / TODO]
- Aisha: Approve temporary quota bump for Frontline and draft Dedicated model pinning how-to (7/21 & 7/27) [TODO / IN PROGRESS]
- Liam: Coordinate network MTU fix with Equinox and confirm VPN stability (7/25) [TODO]
- Karen: Implement routing update logging and propose 2s grace mitigation (7/26) [TODO]
- Samir: Communicate temporary quota bump & update customer on timeline (7/21) [TODO]

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Capture hallucination regression test config and save to repo: gitlab.com/redwood/ps/integrations/tests/atlas-halluc-2026-07 (Diego/Evelyn)
- Consider short-lived canary pool (single-shard) for high-risk customers during major autoscale ops
- Revisit quota & burst policy defaults next planning cycle (product ops)

Decisions made:
- Approve temporary burst quota increase for Frontline CRM for next 48 hours to unblock onboarding (Aisha approved)
- Move Equinox HSM integration to "ready for network" state; network fixes are blocking final sign-off

Risks:
- If routing propagation fix delayed >1 week, expect 1-2% of requests to unexpectedly route to quantized variants during peak traffic windows, potentially impacting output quality for sensitive customers

Next meeting:
- Weekly cadence: keep weekly Wednesday 10:00 PT
- Next scheduled: 2026-07-28 10:00 PT

Appendix / quick links:
- Integration runbook (internal): CONFLUENCE-PS/1234
- Active JIRA board: JIRA-INTG-987
- Load test results (draft): gitlab.com/redwood/ps/loadtests/atlas/2026-07-21

End of notes
